name: 04-publication-policy
caption: Current-key reads on native MinIO: owner credentials can delete a version despite the bucket-policy control; compliance retention protects the data version but not the delete marker. A restricted publisher cannot remove B, while copying old A publishes a new ID. Symbols are row-local aliases, not time or numeric order. These are finite operation traces, not production incidence or an audit of every API.
method: Exact request-index selection, decoded full-body current reads, response status and native version-ID equality. All 60 S3 records are included; 12 plotted observations reuse requests 12 and 14.
